description: site/data/security-review.json is a byte-identical copy of avd-assess's security-review.json (C20, avd-assess-security-review/v1) at commit; tests/site.test.mjs checks the hash. To update: copy the file from avd-assess at a new commit, then update commit and sha256 in the same PR, and rebuild the page (node scripts/site/build-security.mjs).
